partner_result_applied.actual_use: Equation (2.9) in the new report is the partner pair-log/layer-cake estimate with the two-coordinate shear cap replaced by the valid collective scalar projection cap.

additional_premise.theorem: Rogozin--Ball one-dimensional product projection density bound
additional_premise.scope: For independent cap-one coordinates V_j and nonzero a, ||p_(a^T V)||_infinity <= sqrt(2)/||a||_2.

new_result.statement: For Q=2cX1X2+(d/2)(a^T V-beta)^2+ell1 X1+ell2 X2+gamma with all active original coordinates independent and cap-one, ||p_Q||_infinity <= |c|^{-1}H(2|c|/(|d|||a||_2^2)); if the three nonzero eigenvalues c,-c,(d/2)||a||_2^2 all have modulus at least one, the bound is <=4+2log8<8.159. The same constant survives arbitrary outside conditioning that only changes beta, ell1, ell2, gamma, and exact finite-mixture law localization costs nothing.

stress_test: a_N=sqrt(2/N)(1,...,1), c=d=1 gives nonzero spectrum {1,-1,1} while every individual bank coefficient tends to zero; the new collective bound remains <8.159.
